extra_quotes: First -principles calculations were performed using density functional theory (DFT) as implemented in the Vienna Ab -initio Simulation Package (V ASP) [26,27].
The Heyd -Scuseria-Ernzerhof hybrid functional (HSE06) [29,30] was additionally employed to obtain more accurate electronic band gaps.
The band-edge alignment satisfies the OER requirement but provides insufficient driving force for HER, indicating that further band -edge modulation is necessary.
